part_audit.proof: Exact differencing leaves U+E2-E1; iid unit LLN gives projection beta+1/2, not causal beta.
Nonzero Z first stage and centered score; exact ratio expansion plus bounded iid unit CLT/Slutsky give root-N variance 3, not independent-row or exact finite normality.
True marginal mean/variance 10/26; scalar working criterion strictly concave with finite positive-mean maximizer; log delta/sandwich gives 13/50 versus inverse working 1/10.
Earlier Y1 includes E1 while differenced error includes -E1. Relevance 2 and error moment -1 give ratio 3/2; timing alone does not validate exclusion.
Positive exposure probabilities cancel in indicator expectation, preserving interference. Four assignments average to direct target 2, distinct from all-on effect 7/2.
Exact cell means, counterfactual conditional trends and treated weights yield ATT 15/4 versus raw 13/4. Coupled deviations give 15/4-t/2; explicit untreated-post means attain the full interval.

Complete uniform-score worlds supply the local law and global type weights. Only compliers change receipt, yielding Wald 3. Unobserved potentials change ATE from 3 to 14/5 while preserving the whole observed law; designs target different populations/interventions.
Two-step iteration gives A epsilon(t+1)+epsilon(t+2), hence I+AA' and both conditional means.
Four errors are an explicit Gaussian innovation linear map with adjacent covariance 1/2. Mean variance 33/64, not iid 21/64; no conditioning on future lag states or Gaussian squared-error claim.
The continuum (b,1/(4b)) has identical entire baseline process laws. Maintained policy invariance gives 5/2-b/2 and sharp [2,9/4]; inverse b=5-2m proves all values attained.
Both training samples actually fitted; six held-out scores pooled with n_k/N rather than equal fold weights. Divisor-N score variance and estimator variance distinguished.

Complete 18-atom oracle gives ATE 10/3 and variance 104/9. Product exponent -1/15 with boundedness/overlap/positive variance satisfies the fixed-fold theorem. Conditioning is separate for each training set; finite table is not coverage.
Largest passing ranks give full rejection set (1,2) and trimmed (1,2,3). Independent uniform minimum CDF 1-(1-u)^4 demonstrates selected-minimum invalidity, not an uncomputed exact trimmed-BH FDR.
Approved unique scientific keys and tenths conversion yield four schools. Wrong five-record branch changes denominators and contrasts. Exact input/branch checks required beyond repeatability.

Global sharp null fixes both endpoint arrays. All six assignments replay the prespecified maximum rule; inclusive tie-group cumulative masses prove validity. Fixed-endpoint selection gives size 2/3 at alpha=1/3, whereas whole-rule size is zero; weak null does not allow imputation.

Seven integer target rosters yield an exact lattice, distinct from envelope [0,2]. Constructed potential pairs attain each effect. Transport is of hypothetical known effect means, not levels; unreleased k is not secretly recoverable.
